Definition: from G4862 and G837; to increase (grow up) together:--grow together.
BiblicalUsage: In the parable Jesus says to let both the wheat and the tares grow together until the harvest. The good and the bad grow side by side in the same field, and the growing together is the reason the servants must not pull the tares early.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that God lets wheat and tares grow together until the harvest, and I hold that patience is part of faith: He will sort them in His time.
RelatedEvents: The Parable of the Wheat and the Weeds
